parameters.name: CertIdentifier
parameters.description:
The unique identifier of the certificate. You can call the [ListCert](~~455806~~) operation to query the identifier.

*   If the certificate is an SSL certificate, the value of this parameter must be in the {Certificate ID}-cn-hangzhou format.
*   If the certificate is a private certificate, the value of this parameter must be the value of the Identifier field for the private certificate.

parameters.name: CiphertextBlob
parameters.description: The data that you want to decrypt. The value is encoded in Base64.

parameters.name: MessageType
parameters.description:
The value type of the Message parameter. Valid values:

*   RAW: The returned result is raw data encoded in UTF-8.
*   Base64: The returned result is Base64-encoded data. This is the default value.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cas decrypt --cert-identifier 1ef1da5f-38ed-69b3-0000-037781890265 --algorithm RSAESOAEPSHA_1 --ciphertext-blob ZOyIygCyaOW6Gj0000MlNKiuyjfzw= --message-type Base64 --custom-identifier 00006bb538d538c70c01f81jh20000 --warehouse-id 1 --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cas Decrypt --region cn-hangzhou --CiphertextBlob 'ZOyIygCyaOW6Gj0000MlNKiuyjfzw=' --CertIdentifier '1ef1da5f-38ed-69b3-0000-037781890265' --WarehouseId 1 --CustomIdentifier 00006bb538d538c70c01f81jh20000 --Algorithm RSAESOAEPSHA_1 --MessageType Base64
